title.narrative: MOSASWA Cross-border Initiative - Africa - Multicountry Southern Africa MOSASWA (01-Jan-2017-31-Dec-2019)

description.narrative: Multicountry Southern Africa MOSASWA, Malaria, Lubombo Spatial Development Initiative 2 NPC (LSDI-2)This program has the following goals: To build solidarity and work collaboratively as public and private sectors to accelerate and intensify from control to elimination in Southern Mozambique and accelareate to elimination of malaria in Swaziland amd South Africa, so as to achieve zero local transmission in Swaziland, South Africa by 2018 and to enable Maputo to enter the pre-elimination/elimination phase by 2020.. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: To establish and operationalise the MOSASWA malaria cross-border initiative to coordinate, harmonize policies, strengthen sub-national capacity and share expertise and strategic information among the three countries to accelerate to the goal of malaria elimination. Objective 2: To expand and sustain access to malaria elimination interventions across the MOSASWA region with particular focus on mobile and migrant populations (MMPs), malaria risk localities and residents so as to rapidly reduce and interrupt malaria transmission. Objective 3: To strengthen capacity in the three countries for malaria surveillance, operational research and monitoring and evaluation to support elimination efforts, respond to outbreaks and resurgence, and generate evidence for intervention response. Objective 4: To mobilize resources and advocate for increased and sustainable malaria financing to achieve and sustain malaria elimination
